text:
TDK AIsight is seeking a candidate for a Technical Product Manager role supporting our AI Glasses product line. In this role, you'll translate deep technical specifications into clear marketing and product requirements, while working closely with Engineering, Sales, and Business Development to create product collateral for internal and external audiences.
This role requires the ability to understand and create system block diagrams, flow diagrams, and circuit schematics.
What you'll do:
Maintain the product roadmap in partnership with Engineering and leadership
Develop marketing requirements documents (MRDs) and product requirements documents (PRDs)
Create product collateral, including product briefs, datasheets, and application notes
Build epics and user stories, and manage backlog prioritization within Agile/Scrum
Conduct market and competitive research
Create sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, one-pagers, and competitive battlecards
Represent the voice of the customer in cross-functional discussions
What you bring:
Bachelor's degree in engineering
Background in system hardware and software, including embedded systems and sensors such as audio/video and IMUs
5+ years of technical product management experience
Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear specifications and requirements
Experience partnering directly with Engineering and technical teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable in a fast-paced, cross-functional, global environment
Familiarity with Jira and Agile/Scrum
